d:
A colossal bipedal rock-type creature with a charcoal grey body, now featuring an enormous, glowing orange mountain of magma erupting from its back. The magma flows down the sides of the body in molten streams, and the head is crowned with a larger, more intense orange vent. It has three thick, charcoal-colored claws on each hand and massive, pillar-like legs. It has no tail and no wings.
BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
